bash_commands: git status --short | head && git log --oneline -3 && ls src/pretix/base/services/ && grep -rn "periodic" src/pretix --include=*.py | grep -v tests | head -40
grep -rn "expire_orders\|payment_term_expire_automatically" --include=*.py . | head -30; grep -n "def expire\|periodic_task.*expire" -r pretix | head

sed -n 1070,1085p pretix/base/settings.py; echo ----; sed -n 925,960p pretix/base/models/orders.py; echo ----; grep -n "def set_expires" -A30 pretix/base/models/orders.py | head -50; echo ----; sed -n 30,60p pretix/base/services/cleanup.py; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p pretix/helpers/periodic.py | sed -n 25,80p

grep -rln "send_expiry_warnings\|mark_order_expired" tests | head; grep -rn "periodic_task.send\|periodic_task" pretix/base/management/commands/*.py pretix/base/signals.py | head; grep -n "def test_.*expir" tests/base/test_orders.py | head -40

sed -n 1,80p tests/base/test_orders.py | grep -n "import\|^def \|fixture" ; grep -n "^class \|send_expiry_warnings\|mark_order_expired" tests/base/test_orders.py | head -60; grep -n "class.*Expir\|class .*Periodic" -r tests | head
sed -n 40,62p tests/base/test_orders.py; sed -n 660,784p tests/base/test_orders.py; sed -n 1,20p pretix/base/services/orders.py | head -3; sed -n 100,110p pretix/base/services/orders.py
timeout 590 python -m pytest tests/base/test_orders.py -k "OrderExpireTests or PaymentReminderTests" -q -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -30

(python -m flake8 pretix/base/services/orders.py tests/base/test_orders.py && echo FLAKE_OK); (python -m isort -c pretix/base/services/orders.py tests/base/test_orders.py && echo ISORT_OK); ls tests/helpers 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "runperiodic\|minimum_interval" tests | head
python -m flake8 pretix/base/services/orders.py tests/base/test_orders.py; echo "flake8 exit $?"; python -m isort -c pretix/base/services/orders.py tests/base/test_orders.py; echo "isort exit $?"
